question: According to Census of India 2011, India's population accounts for ________ of the world's population.
solution:
The correct answer is __**17.5%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, India's population accounts for approximately **17.5%** of the world's population.
 
• The **world population** at that time was estimated to be around **7 billion**, and India's population was about **1.21 billion**.
 
• India is the **second most populous country** in the world, after China.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every **10 years** and is the primary source of data on the country's demographics.
 
• This percentage highlights the significant share of the global population that resides in India, reflecting its demographic importance on the world stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Census of India**__

 __
 
• The Census of India is conducted by the **Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner** under the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• The first census in India was conducted in the year **1872**.
 
• The most recent census was conducted in **2011**, and the next was scheduled for **2021** but has been delayed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Demographic Importance**__
 
 
• India's large population has significant implications for its **economy, environment, and social policies**.
 
• Understanding demographic data is crucial for **planning and development** in areas such as **healthcare, education, and infrastructure**.
